design_philosophy: Awwwards-Worthy Industrial Brutalism. Combining high-fidelity hardware photography with stark, technical typography. Employs the 'Swiss Grid' influence with deliberate asymmetrical tension, massive typography, and premium kinetic motion.

headings.usage: Massive, tracking-tight (tracking-tighter), uppercase for major impact. Used in Kinetic Hero and Section Headers.

body_and_tech.usage: Used for all technical specs, numbering (01, 02), buttons, and form inputs. Establishes a hardware-engineering, data-heavy vibe.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #262626 on all technical cards and layout boundaries. Sharp edges (rounded-none).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle fixed grain overlay (pointer-events-none, mix-blend-overlay, opacity-20) across the entire site.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Micro-interactions: images scale up (zoom) slightly inside clipped frames, borders illuminate, monospace text shifts to accent color.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px borders and stark contrast instead of soft drop shadows.

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling is MANDATORY. Provides the premium 'weight' required for Awwwards-level sites.
motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic line-by-line reveal using framer-motion. Text lines wrapped in overflow-hidden containers and translated up on load.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on hero background using framer-motion useScroll or mouse position tracking to create a 3D depth effect.

components.name: KineticHero
components.instructions: 100vh height. Background image (PCB macro) with bg-black/70 overlay. Center massive 'Outfit' text masking in line by line. Text: 'PRECISION. LAYER BY LAYER.'. Bottom area features a subtle scroll indicator and technical data in JetBrains Mono.

components.name: EditorialMarquee
components.instructions: Use react-fast-marquee. Font: JetBrains Mono, text-sm, tracking-widest, uppercase. Slower speed, border-y border-border, py-4. Content: '• UP TO 4-LAYER PCBs • PROUDLY MADE IN KUNDLI, HARYANA • RAPID PROTOTYPING • HIGH VOLUME PRODUCTION •'

components.name: ManifestoChapters
components.instructions: Vertical staggered layout. Large sequential numbers (01, 02) in accent color (JetBrains Mono). Content in Outfit. Generous vertical space (py-32), offset alignment (left then right).

components.name: CapabilitiesBento
components.instructions: Grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-1. Use Mode A 'Tetris' Grid logic. High density technical specs. Cards have flat background (#0A0A0A), 1px border. Hover state triggers a subtle spotlight effect.

components.name: SpotlightGallery
components.instructions: Images in clipped frames (aspect-square or aspect-video, overflow-hidden). Images are grayscale by default; on hover, they transition to full color and scale up (1.05x).

components.name: QuoteForm
components.instructions: Strict, sharp edges (rounded-none). Use Shadcn UI logic but stripped to match brutalist aesthetic. Include a prominent file upload area with a dashed border for Gerber/ZIP files. Accent colored submit button.

hero_background.alt: Dark blue macro Printed Circuit Board
hero_background.usage: Hero section background with heavy dark overlay

gallery.alt: Green circuit board components close up

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: NEVER use generic placeholder images (no dummyimage, via.placeholder.com). Use the provided URLs.
DO NOT apply 'transition: all'. Target specific properties (e.g., transition-transform, transition-colors).
NO rounded corners on main containers; use sharp edges (rounded-none) for the industrial brutalist look.
Ensure minimum WCAG AA contrast for text over images by using dark overlays (bg-black/60 to bg-black/80).
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='quote-submit-button').
Include a subtle noise/grain texture overlaid across the entire app with pointer-events-none.
Use generous padding (p-12 to p-32) for section separation to prevent cramped layouts.
Force dark mode styling across the entire application to maintain the moody, high-end technical aesthetic.
All grids must maintain 1px inner borders to feel like an engineering schematic.
Do not center-align paragraphs; left-align to maintain reading flow and brutalist structure.
